about: Catalogue expansion for the beta. Facts (year, length, credits) were compiled from general knowledge; where an open source matches a work, its values replace these and the change is recorded (fact_sources). Terms, advisories and summaries are AI-assisted readings awaiting editorial review. Ratings are unverified.

works.title: Halloween
works.summary: Fifteen years after killing his sister, Michael Myers escapes an asylum and returns to his small Illinois town on Halloween night.

works.title: The Exorcist
works.summary: When a twelve-year-old girl in Washington begins to change in terrifying ways, her mother turns to two priests.

works.title: Psycho
works.summary: A secretary on the run with stolen cash stops for the night at a remote motel run by a shy young man and his unseen mother.

graphic-violence: A shower murder, shown in rapid cuts.

works.title: Rosemary's Baby
works.summary: A young wife in a Manhattan apartment block grows convinced her too-friendly neighbours have plans for her unborn child.

works.title: The Babadook
works.summary: A widowed mother, worn down by grief and her difficult son, reads him a picture book about a creature who will not leave.

works.title: It Follows
works.summary: After a sexual encounter, a teenager is pursued by a slow, shape-shifting presence that only she can see.

works.title: The Witch
works.summary: Banished from their Puritan settlement in 1630s New England, a family farming at the edge of a wood begins to turn on itself.

works.title: Ringu
works.summary: A reporter investigates a videotape rumoured to kill anyone who watches it within seven days, and then watches it.

works.title: The Others
works.summary: In a fog-bound house on Jersey after the war, a mother keeps her light-sensitive children in darkness, until the house seems to have other ideas.

works.title: Coraline
works.summary: Bored in her new home, a girl finds a small door to a better version of it, with an Other Mother who has buttons for eyes.

jump-scares: Creepy images that may frighten young children.

works.title: The Nightmare Before Christmas
works.summary: Jack Skellington, bored king of Halloween Town, stumbles into Christmas Town and decides to run Christmas his way.

works.title: Beetlejuice
works.summary: A recently deceased couple hire a manic bio-exorcist to scare the new owners out of their beloved country house.

works.title: Hocus Pocus
works.summary: A teenager new to Salem lights a candle on Halloween night and brings back three seventeenth-century witch sisters.

works.title: Shaun of the Dead
works.summary: A London electronics salesman with a stalled life tries to win back his girlfriend just as the dead start walking.

works.title: What We Do in the Shadows
works.summary: A documentary crew follows four vampire flatmates in Wellington as they argue about dishes and prepare for the Unholy Masquerade.

works.title: ParaNorman
works.summary: A boy who talks to ghosts is the only one who can stop a centuries-old witch's curse from raising his town's dead.

works.title: Scream
works.summary: A year after her mother's murder, a teenager in a small California town is targeted by a masked killer who knows his horror films.

works.title: Stree
works.summary: In a small town where a ghostly woman abducts men during an annual festival, a ladies' tailor and his friends try to outwit her.

works.title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa
works.summary: A young couple move into his family's supposedly haunted palace, and an unorthodox psychiatrist friend arrives to get to the bottom of it.

works.title: The Wailing
works.summary: A bumbling policeman in a mountain village investigates a wave of violent illness that the villagers blame on a Japanese stranger.

works.title: Kwaidan
works.summary: Four Japanese ghost stories, painted in stylised sets: a samurai's first wife, the snow woman, a blind musician and a face in a cup of tea.

works.title: Nosferatu
works.summary: An estate agent travels to the Carpathians to sell a house to Count Orlok, who follows him home with plague in his wake.

works.title: Midsommar
works.summary: A grieving young woman joins her distant boyfriend and his friends at a Swedish midsummer festival held once every ninety years.

suicide-self-harm: A ritual suicide shown in full.

works.title: The Conjuring
works.summary: In 1971, paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren help a family terrorised by a dark presence in their Rhode Island farmhouse.

works.title: The Haunting of Hill House
works.summary: Five grown siblings, haunted in different ways by the summer their family spent in Hill House, are pulled back together by a death.

works.title: Wednesday
works.summary: Wednesday Addams starts at Nevermore Academy for outcasts and sets about solving a string of monstrous killings in the nearby town.

works.title: Midnight Mass
works.summary: A disgraced young man and a charismatic new priest arrive on a dying island community at the same time, and miracles follow.

works.title: It's a Wonderful Life
works.summary: On Christmas Eve, a desperate small-town banker is shown by an angel what Bedford Falls would have become without him.

works.title: Home Alone
works.summary: Left behind when his family flies to Paris for Christmas, an eight-year-old defends the house from two bumbling burglars.

works.title: Elf
works.summary: Raised by elves at the North Pole, a very tall human travels to New York to find his father, who is on the naughty list.

works.title: Love Actually
works.summary: Eight loosely linked London love stories play out over the five weeks before Christmas.

works.title: The Holiday
works.summary: Two women unlucky in love, one in Los Angeles and one in Surrey, swap homes for Christmas and fall for the locals.

works.title: Klaus
works.summary: A spoiled postman exiled to a feuding Arctic island strikes up an unlikely partnership with a reclusive toymaker.

works.title: Arthur Christmas
works.summary: When Santa's high-tech operation misses one child, his clumsy younger son sets off with Grandsanta's old sleigh to deliver the present.

works.title: The Muppet Christmas Carol
works.summary: Michael Caine's Scrooge is visited by three spirits, with Gonzo as Charles Dickens and Kermit as Bob Cratchit.

works.title: Die Hard
works.summary: An off-duty New York cop is the only hope for hostages when thieves seize a Los Angeles tower during a Christmas party.

works.title: Miracle on 34th Street
works.summary: A department-store Santa who insists he is the real thing ends up in court, and a sceptical girl starts to wonder.

works.title: The Polar Express
works.summary: On Christmas Eve a doubting boy boards a mysterious train bound for the North Pole.

works.title: Last Christmas
works.summary: A London elf-shop worker drifting after an illness meets a young man who keeps appearing just when she needs him.

works.title: Carol
works.summary: In 1950s New York, a young shop assistant and an elegant older woman in the middle of a divorce fall in love over the Christmas season.

works.title: Gremlins
works.summary: A boy is given a cute creature for Christmas with three rules attached; when they are broken, his small town is overrun.

works.title: The Holdovers
works.summary: Over Christmas 1970, a curmudgeonly teacher at a New England boarding school is stuck minding a troubled student and the grieving head cook.

works.title: Happiest Season
works.summary: A woman plans to propose to her girlfriend at her family's Christmas, then learns her girlfriend hasn't come out to them.

works.title: A Christmas Carol
works.summary: On Christmas Eve, the miser Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by the ghost of his partner and three spirits of Christmas.

works.title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas!
works.summary: A grumpy creature living above Who-ville tries to stop Christmas by stealing every present and decoration.

works.title: A Charlie Brown Christmas
works.summary: Gentle jazz piano and children's voices written for the Peanuts Christmas special.

works.title: Merry Christmas
works.summary: Carols, gospel and the brand-new "All I Want for Christmas Is You".

works.title: Call Me by Your Name
works.summary: In the summer of 1983 in northern Italy, a seventeen-year-old falls for the American graduate student staying with his family.

works.title: Brokeback Mountain
works.summary: Two young ranch hands who fall in love one summer in 1963 Wyoming spend the next twenty years unable to be together or apart.

works.title: Happy Together
works.summary: Two men from Hong Kong, stranded in Buenos Aires, break up and get back together in a love that keeps going wrong.

works.title: Paris Is Burning
works.summary: A portrait of New York's drag ball culture in the late 1980s and the Black and Latino queer and trans people who made it.

works.title: Pride
works.summary: In 1984, a group of gay and lesbian activists in London raise money for striking miners in a Welsh village that isn't sure it wants their help.

works.title: Tangerine
works.summary: On Christmas Eve in Los Angeles, a trans sex worker just out of jail tears across the city looking for the boyfriend who cheated on her.

works.title: Milk
works.summary: The story of Harvey Milk, the first openly gay man elected to public office in California, from 1970 to his assassination in 1978.

works.title: Aligarh
works.summary: A shy Marathi professor at Aligarh Muslim University is suspended after being filmed with another man, and a young reporter takes up his story.

works.title: Ek Ladki Ko Dekha Toh Aisa Laga
works.summary: A Punjabi family busy marrying off their daughter doesn't realise the person she loves is a woman.

works.title: Kapoor & Sons
works.summary: Two estranged brothers return to their bickering family in Coonoor when their grandfather has a heart attack, and secrets surface.

works.title: Heartstopper
works.summary: At a boys' grammar school, quiet Charlie falls for rugby player Nick, who is figuring out who he is too.

suicide-self-harm: An eating disorder and self-harm in later seasons.

works.title: Pose
works.summary: Ballroom houses in 1980s and '90s New York, led by trans women of colour, compete, fight and care for each other through the AIDS crisis.

works.title: Schitt's Creek
works.summary: A rich family loses everything and has to live in the run-down motel of the small town they once bought as a joke.

works.title: Sex Education
works.summary: A sex therapist's awkward teenage son sets up an underground advice clinic at his school with the girl who sees its business potential.

works.title: Fun Home
works.summary: A graphic memoir about growing up in a funeral home with a closeted father, and the author's own coming out.

works.title: Giovanni's Room
works.summary: Waiting in Paris for his fiancée, a young American falls into an affair with an Italian bartender he cannot bring himself to claim.

works.title: Red, White & Royal Blue
works.summary: The son of the American president and a British prince fake a friendship after a public spat, and fall in love.

works.title: Orlando
works.summary: An Elizabethan nobleman lives for centuries and wakes one day as a woman.

works.title: Gone Home
works.summary: Returning from a year abroad to her family's new house on a stormy night, a young woman finds it empty and pieces together what happened.

works.title: Tell Me Why
works.summary: Twins reunite in their Alaskan hometown after ten years, and one of them, a trans man, faces the memories of their mother's death.

relationships: A musical Muppet adaptation that keeps much of Dickens's narration.
